subject.title: [Bug]: Release notes verifier omits valid source PRs

question: Should the 2026.7.1 release remain blocked until the contribution verifier produces an ancestry-complete, provenance-auditable record?
rationale: The source defect is clear and the issue explicitly marks the release as blocked, but only release owners can decide whether completeness is a hard publication gate for this train.

options.title: Keep release blocked
options.body: Require the ancestry-complete verifier and reconciled contribution manifest before publishing or claiming a complete release record.

options.title: Ship with explicit limitation
options.body: Permit publication only with a maintainer-approved statement that the contribution record is incomplete and must be corrected afterward.

recommendation.title: Keep release blocked
recommendation.body: Require the ancestry-complete verifier and reconciled contribution manifest before publishing or claiming a complete release record.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the assigned issue owner and supplied the release-specific reconciliation and blocker assessment.
